item.title: Koreans call for end to nuclear ahead of Fukushima anniversary
item.description: Catholics in Seoul have begun a series of public Masses opposing the extension and expansion of nuclear power plants, ahead of the 15th anniversary of the Fukushima disaster. Source: Vatican News.

item.title: Leaders urge Asia-Pacific governments to go for goals
item.description: Governments in the Asia-Pacific region should prioritise structural justice and youth empowerment so the region can progress to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals by 2030, Catholic leaders said at a regional gathering. Source: UCA News.

item.title: AI can become ‘a threat to the true good of humanity’
item.description: The International Theological Commission has issued a new document asserting that “the life of the human being is vocation”, while warning that scientific and technological advances must be accompanied by an increase in responsibility, ensuring that progress benefits the person. Source: EWTN News.

item.title: Pilgrims hold reunion three months after Australian Catholic Youth Festival
item.description: Gathering with 6000 pilgrims was just the beginning, Melbourne Archbishop Peter A Comensoli told a crowd of young people on Saturday, as they gathered for an Australian Catholic Youth Festival reunion. Source: Melbourne Catholic.

item.title: Parishes begin their journey to Eucharist28
item.description: “The Eucharistic Congress is not just one week in 2028. It starts now.” That was the clear message from a Sydney parish planning workshop for the International Eucharistic Congress. Source: The Catholic Weekly.

item.title: Catholic educator steps down after 30 years of promoting excellence
item.description: After more than 30 years in Catholic education – four of them as executive director of Brisbane Catholic Education – Sally Towns has resigned for health reasons. Source: The Catholic Leader.

item.title: Bishop’s pastoral letter marks International Women’s Day
item.description: The Australian Catholic Bishops Conference bishop delegate for women, Bishop Michael Morrissey, has written a pastoral letter to mark International Women’s Day on Sunday, March 8. Source: ACBC Media Blog.

item.title: Church is holy by Christ’s presence, not human perfection: Pope
item.description: The Catholic Church is both a community made up of fragile and limited human beings and a divine reality, Pope Leo XIV said at his weekly general audience. Source: CNS.

item.title: Bishops join call for peace in Middle East
item.description: The Australian Catholic Bishops Conference has joined Pope Leo XIV and many world leaders in expressing deep alarm at the escalating violence engulfing the Middle East.
